concept: A massive interconnected web of dominoes and gears, partially collapsed and on fire, suspended over a churning ocean during a storm. The structure is half-destroyed, with some pieces still falling, others frozen mid-tumble. Lightning illuminates the chaos. Style: bold geometric forms, high contrast, dramatic diagonal composition, industrial and dystopian. Colors should read as deep blues, oranges, and blacks even in duotone.
explanation: Today's news depicts a world system under simultaneous stress across multiple dimensions: economic destabilization (tariffs, stock falls, trading volatility), catastrophic infrastructure failures (fires, plane incidents, floods), political instability (Netanyahu, jihadism shifting), and environmental hazards (asteroid defense, climate-driven flooding). No single story dominates—instead, they form an interconnected cascade of failures and uncertainties. The falling dominoes represent how fragile systems collapse when multiple pressures compound.
